question: In 2019 an EU vote targeted summer time. What did it abolish?
answer: The EU vote of 4 March 2019 did not abolish summer time. It abolished the twice-yearly switch between summer and winter time. Each country may keep one of them all year.
move: The EU ended the twice-yearly switch, not summer time: each country picks one hour for good.
